name: print-social-designer-resume-collage-on-graph-paper-with-tape-and-colour-tags
title: Long resume on crumpled graph paper with 'Hi!' letters, taped polaroid, folder bio, black label headings and coloured skill tags
whatItIs: A tall crumpled grid-paper page with a window bar and pink and lime 'Hi!' letters with a chrome exclamation mark, a manila folder holding the bio, a taped polaroid of the designer on a green cutting mat with a hello sticker, black label headings in monospace (Contact me, Work experience, Education, Tools, Skills, Languages), dated black pills, coloured tag chips per job, app icons and doodle stickers.
whatItMeans: Playful and warm; craft objects make a CV feel handmade and memorable.
techniques: Attach photos with tape and clips.
Add star stickers and a stylus.

vocabulary.definition: A heading on a black label strip.
A small coloured capsule naming a skill.
A black capsule with a year.
A layout made from stationery objects.
